title: Lectures to My Students
author: Charles Haddon Spurgeon

translation.name: Lectures to My Students — Charles Haddon Spurgeon

rights: Public domain (published 1875; author d. 1892). Scan and OCR: Internet Archive.
citation: Spurgeon, C. H. Lectures to My Students: A Selection from Addresses Delivered to the Students of the Pastors’ College, Metropolitan Tabernacle. First series. London: Passmore & Alabaster, 1875. Public domain; Internet Archive scan.
editorialMarkers: Spurgeon to his own students: the call, prayer, the voice, the choice of text, spiritualising, the ministry’s depressions. Plain, Baptist, London, 1875; the most-read English manual on the preacher’s life.
method: Internet Archive OCR text per volume; treatises open at a capitalised title block (“A TREATISE …”, “THE nth BOOK OF THE TREATISE …”); paragraphs by blank lines; page numbers, lone running heads and volume signatures dropped; hyphenation joined; the index and catalogue matter cut. The scan’s own damage is repaired: headings whose letters the scanner misread, the translator’s footnotes standing as paragraphs of the work, the publisher’s sales catalogue, and words split by the gutter. A letter is corrected only where the printed word is not in doubt — a token no lexicon knows with exactly one candidate; anything ambiguous is left as scanned.
